items.der: The last word decides, and Lampe is feminine.
items.das: The last word decides, and Lampe is feminine.

items.der: The last word decides, and Bahn is feminine.
items.das: The last word decides, and Bahn is feminine.

items.der: The last word decides, and Zimmer is neuter.
items.die: The last word decides, and Zimmer is neuter.

items.e: -e does not make a feminine job title here. The suffix is -in.
items.chen: -chen makes small things and is always neuter.

items.keit: -keit follows -ig, -lich or -bar. A short adjective takes -heit.

items.heit: -heit makes nouns from adjectives. planen is a verb.
items.schaft: -schaft does not make a noun from planen.

items.sam: -sam gives other meanings, such as sparsam. It does not mean „can be done“.

items.s: Blume ends in -e and takes the joint -n: Blumenvase.
items.e: There is no joint -e here. Blume takes -n.

items.be: bebrochen is not a word. The prefix meaning „apart“ is zer-.

items.er: erkauft means „gained by paying“. „Sold“ is verkauft.

items.gestudiert: Verbs ending in -ieren take no ge-.
items.studieren: This is the Infinitiv. The Perfekt needs the Partizip: studiert.

items.gerenoviert: Verbs ending in -ieren take no ge-.
items.renovierte: renovierte is the Präteritum. The Perfekt needs the Partizip: renoviert.

items.gebearbeitet: Verbs starting with be- take no ge-.
items.bearbeiten: This is the Infinitiv. The Perfekt needs the Partizip: bearbeitet.

items.reich: -reich means „rich in something good“. fehlerreich is not used.
items.voll: fehlervoll is not the normal word.
